format: CSV with one row per direction-input-output complex transfer estimate
acceptance: All 72 cells are unique and present; one common LO, metric, epoch, and environment manifest are frozen; both maps are independently source-derived; J_forward is unitary and J_reverse*J_forward is identity in the declared basis.
physical_boundary: The exact analyzer accepts rational complex estimates. A physical run additionally needs independently preregistered uncertainty regions and residual thresholds.
